milestone: Define the final metadata-only gate required before H1 can be reconsidered for the candidate3 transition.
decision_changed: A two-snapshot PASS may satisfy only the metadata responsiveness component of H1 re-entry; it never authorizes a launch and cannot replace any other conjunctive gate.
cheapest_adequate_test: One nonrecursive directory enumeration and five no-follow metadata stats of an existing compact immutable packet at each post-remediation snapshot.
completion_condition: Source-bound contract, local positive/negative/timeout fixtures, immutable review packet, and independent implementation review; no live execution of the runner during preparation.
permitted_live_operation: Open only live_target as a directory; fstat the directory; enumerate its immediate names exactly once; lstat each expected member with follow_symlinks=false; compare type and byte size; close the directory. Do not recurse, glob, hash, open, or read member-file content.

preconditions: Separately authorized host-administrator remediation has completed.
At this snapshot, no project-relevant D-state task on /mnt is present.
At this snapshot, three consecutive one-second vmstat samples each show b=0 and iowait<10%.
No whole-root search or blocked sync survives.
placement.snapshot_1: Run exactly once immediately after all snapshot-1 preconditions pass.
placement.snapshot_2: Run exactly once no earlier than 600 seconds after a source-and-contract-bound snapshot_1 PASS receipt completed, only after all snapshot-2 preconditions independently pass. The runner enforces the predecessor binding and numeric gap before touching the live target.
placement.after_both_pass: Run the candidate3 managed-launch resource/dedup prestart from scratch. A probe PASS does not waive or pre-answer that prestart.

receipt_policy: Receipts are written atomically to local storage and never to /mnt. Existing receipts are never overwritten. Timeout, worker error, malformed worker output, contract/source hash mismatch, unexpected member/type/size, receipt-write failure, or an unreaped worker all fail closed. Preserve every failure and do not retry without a new coordinator decision.

outcome_interpretation.PASS_METADATA_GATE: This one snapshot's exact metadata operation completed inside five seconds, returned the expected immutable directory metadata, and the worker was reaped. This establishes only this snapshot's metadata-gate component.
outcome_interpretation.BLOCKED_TIMEOUT: The metadata gate failed. H1 remains unavailable. If the worker is unreaped, report its PID for administrator handling; do not issue another probe.
outcome_interpretation.BLOCKED_METADATA_OPERATION: The metadata gate failed due to an operation, schema, membership, type, size, or worker-output error. H1 remains unavailable; do not retry automatically.
outcome_interpretation.BLOCKED_RECEIPT_WRITE: The attempt is unusable because durable local provenance was not preserved. H1 remains unavailable; do not retry automatically.

resource_bounds.live_attempts: At most one worker per declared snapshot and at most two total after remediation.
resource_bounds.cpu_gpu: No GPU; one short Python parent and one worker only.
resource_bounds.stop_condition: Stop immediately on any non-PASS result, timeout, unreaped worker, missing precondition, existing receipt, or unexpected state.

explicit_exclusions: No execution of this runner or repeated probe against the currently blocked live mount during contract preparation or review. The author performed one disclosed pre-freeze, nonrecursive exact-member stat to bind the five expected types and sizes; it completed in 0.2 seconds and is not a re-entry result.
No recording or voltage file access.
No recursive traversal, whole-root search, content read, hash, transfer, service, GPU, sort, process mutation, mount mutation, H5 contact, RF, or holdout access.
No launch authorization and no claim of current H5 readiness.
frozen_interpretation: Both metadata snapshots must PASS alongside every other conjunctive re-entry gate before H1 is merely eligible for a fresh managed prestart. Any failure leaves H1 unavailable; passing does not prove scientific validity, storage throughput, recording readability, or launch safety.
